worktree_policy: dirty uncommitted worktree preserved; no reset/clean/commit/push; prior MCP003 evidence remains in place
scope: Runtime, authenticated IPC and explicit opt-in MCP wire candidate/approval/restore transaction core plus manifest-only diagnostic export; no 3D generation or image upload
implementation: Candidate@1 now binds prepared object ID/hash and quality hard-gate state.
candidate_prepare creates a hash-bound candidate, durable RuntimeJob and audit event in one transaction.
candidate_confirm validates project scope, candidate state, base, object/hash, quality, approval expiry and idempotency before one atomic immutable version plus snapshot commit.

Runtime mints the durable receipt ID inside confirm/reject/export transactions; the caller-supplied approval_receipt_id is retained only as approval context and is not used as the persisted receipt identity.
candidate_reject persists an explicit approval decision without changing the confirmed head.
restore_prepare binds a historical confirmed source version to a new candidate based on the current head; restore_confirm creates a new child version and never moves the historical pointer.

export_prepare creates a path-free manifest-json diagnostic object in CAS; export_confirm binds approval, version, artifact hashes and idempotency without creating a filesystem path or claiming GLB export.
Authenticated local IPC dispatches candidate, restore and diagnostic export transactions plus job_cancel; the MCP003 stdio tool manifest remains read-only.

forgecad-mcp now exposes the MCP004 write tools only when the backend is authenticated or dynamic Runtime IPC and FORGECAD_MCP_ENABLE_MCP004_WRITES=1; the default connection remains a 16-tool read-only surface and initialize does not call Runtime. The opt-in surface includes project_create and the bounded non-visual typed=diagnostic candidate path.
A development forgecad-runtime serve launcher creates a protected authenticated Unix IPC handoff and an explicit no-image/no-geometry diagnostic fixture; it is not a signed release launcher.

forgecad-mcp owns stdio, starts the same-package Runtime asynchronously through bounded Starting/Ready/Degraded/Restarting states, reconnects through ready/status handoff, and keeps the Runtime token out of the parent environment.
A real authenticated Codex CLI diagnostic turn completed the bounded candidate/restore/export write sequence and read back the resulting project/version state.
Legacy Runtime V1 databases receive additive columns for the new candidate and approval bindings without opening the old Library.
Diagnostic fixture approval and idempotency identifiers are scoped to each fixture project, so repeated host startup cannot collide with prior diagnostic records.
The MVP Runtime process owns an OS writer file lock; normal process exit releases it and a second Runtime reports RUNTIME_BUSY while the first is alive.
The optional Tauri Viewer reads project, version and head-snapshot projections through authenticated local IPC; it does not start Runtime or open SQLite/CAS.
Normal serve --stdio never enables the diagnostic fixture; fixture, signing and notarization remain independent test/release gates.
